# Total Revenue per Month

This report shows how much revenue the game makes each month.

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

revenue <- read.csv("RevenueMonth.csv")

ggplot(revenue, aes(x = Month, y = TotalRevenue)) +
  geom_col(fill = "blue") +
  labs(title = "Total Revenue per Month", x = "Month", y = "Total Revenue") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```
